name: eEducation Albert AB (publ)
summary: eEducation Albert AB (publ) is a global provider of digital learning solutions. The company's core offering is an app-based educational platform, catering to children and adolescents from 3 to 16 years old. This platform encompasses a variety of specialized applications: 'Albert' focuses on mathematics for children aged 10-16, a demographic also served by 'Albert Teen'. Younger students, from 3 to 9 years old, can engage with 'Junior' for math competitions, 'Albert ABC' for reading skills, and 'Albert Code' for an introduction to programming. Additionally, the company offers 'Albert English' for second language learners and 'Albert Geo' to teach geography to 10-16 year olds. These digital learning tools are made available through a subscription model. Established in 2015, eEducation Albert AB (publ) maintains its headquarters in Gothenburg, Sweden.
